notes:
Opportunity summary: mid-market B2B SaaS (product analytics) building an in-app support agent + doc search. Initially evaluated Redwood Hosted API — positive on latency and quality. Now moving to Dedicated POC to validate steady throughput and cost predictability under peak sessions.

POC goals (explicit):
- Validate Dedicated pool with 8x T4s equivalent throughput for peak: target p95 token-latency <= 200ms for short-chat flows (<=512 tokens), steady QPS 60 concurrent sessions.
- Measure unit cost delta Hosted vs Dedicated (expected 30-45% reduction at commit levels).
- Prove canary routing and rollback: start with 5% traffic to Dedicated canary, ramp to 25% then 100% over 48-72h windows if metrics steady.

Canary + fallback routing plan (agreed with SE):
- Canary: 5% of production traffic for 48h -> monitor p95 latency, error rate, token throughput, quality regressions (user satisfaction set).
- Metrics thresholds to abort/r ollback: error rate >2% sustained over 1h OR p95 latency >300ms for 3 consecutive hours OR quality regression (BLEU/QA score delta) beyond agreed guardrails.
- Fallback routing: Immediate traffic switch to Hosted API + smaller quantized model variant (ramp down by routing policy) on detected regression.
- Model variants: primary = open-llm-13B-quantized-8bit (optimized), fallback = open-llm-7B-quantized-8bit, hosted fallback = vendor-curated low-cost variant.
- Region failover: primary region us-west-2; secondary region eu-west-1 for EU traffic. Routing policy: geo-based + health checks; automatic failover to secondary region if primary fails health probes for >5m.
- Rollback: automated rollback policy via Console if health checks fail post-canary or manual rollback option for AE/SE with one-click rollback in Console.

Security & compliance notes:
- Customer requires SSO (SAML) + KMS for key management; Redwood to provide SAML metadata and KMS integration guide.
- Data residency: EU residency required for customer EU clients; will map routing policy to keep EU traffic in eu-west-1 during POC.
- Audit logs retention: request for 12 months of token-level audit logs for initial evaluation (cost impact discussed).

Operational instrumentation & evals:
- Tracing hooks (x-request-id) + per-token cost breakdown required. SE will add SDK headers for sampling.
- Quality monitoring: customer will run 1k prompts from their regression set daily; Redwood Optimize suggestions to be evaluated for quantization/latency tradeoffs.

Commercial notes:
- Customer prefers to pilot with a 3-month Dedicated POC (discounted reserved capacity) before committing to annual reserved. Finance wants a modeled run-rate for 12 months to compare to Hosted spend. Estimated ARR if convert: 50k-200k.
- Pricing ask: firm request for committed tier pricing + overage rates. AE (Maya) to send firm proposal by 2025-11-10.

Quotes / paraphrases from stakeholders:
- "We like the throughput but need predictable unit costs; if Dedicated yields 30% savings at our load we move fast." — VP Product
- "Can we guarantee region failover without data egress issues?" — Head of Infra
